name: PayPal
description: The PayPal MCP server enables AI agents to interact with the PayPal platform. PayPal is a global online payments system that supports online money transfers and serves as an electronic alternative to traditional paper methods like checks and money orders. This MCP server allows AI assistants to programmatically access and manage PayPal account information, transaction details, payment processing, and potentially other financial services offered by PayPal.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PayPal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PayPal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.paypal.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PayPal MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PayPal lists 28 MCP tools, including create_product, list_product, show_product_details, list_disputes, get_dispute, accept_dispute_claim, create_invoice, list_invoices, get_invoice, send_invoice, send_invoice_reminder, and cancel_sent_invoice.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PayPal?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PayPal in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
PayPal requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PayPal is developed by PayPal. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
